what_was_tested: Setup and execution of initial experiment gates; not a confirmatory test of IDT/SCT/CGM
benchmark_conclusion: Readiness evidence only
scope_or_caveat: Do not treat as scientific validation

what_was_tested: Recovery of generator-expected operation signatures in synthetic trace tasks
comparisons: Expected operation signatures across five seeds
benchmark_conclusion: Repeatable operation-level recovery in known synthetic vocabulary
pressure_summary: Moderate recurrence evidence; weak external decision pressure
scope_or_caveat: Generator, solver vocabulary, labels overlap

what_was_tested: Association between invariant strength and later transfer
benchmark_conclusion: Early positive association in sparse pool; later corrected 13D not replicated
scope_or_caveat: About 4.4 promoted candidates per seed; corrected 13D relation near zero/non-positive

what_was_tested: ASFT vs frequency-only/no-transfer/rand ranking on primary top-k outcome
benchmark_conclusion: Primary strict gate failed; informed rankers tied
pressure_summary: None for informed policy ranking; same order in five seeds
scope_or_caveat: No observed ranking disagreement; low discriminative leverage

what_was_tested: Variation survival, ranking stability, sparse evidence performance
benchmark_conclusion: Mixed diagnostics: VST 1.0, rank stability .72, sparse recall .20
scope_or_caveat: Synthetic only; measures do not all validate same construct

what_was_tested: Injected frequent no-op marker in three of four families
benchmark_conclusion: Transfer-aware ranker demoted designed confound; exploratory mechanism sensitivity
pressure_summary: High for injected confound, none for natural superiority
scope_or_caveat: Post-primary exploratory test; does not repair 13B gate

what_was_tested: Candidate conversion and skill selection across confirmation seeds
benchmark_conclusion: 44 reflection/rotation skills; SCT ties always/random at .345
pressure_summary: None for selection: 44/44 selected; random-create p=1
scope_or_caveat: Synthetic candidates; policy did not make genuine choices

what_was_tested: Applied SCT skill opportunities and cross-family attempts
primary_measures: 201 correct positive-credit uses; .227 normalized reduction among correct
comparisons: SCT vs MEMORY_ONLY and other creation policies
benchmark_conclusion: Reuse and simulator step-cost savings observed; memory-only stronger on net value
pressure_summary: Moderate outcome pressure; memory opportunity counts unequal
scope_or_caveat: Generated task stream and two skill families

what_was_tested: Raw trace-exemplar retrieval vs learned skills
primary_measures: Net value, application and correctness rates
benchmark_conclusion: Memory-only net value 1.325 vs SCT .345; strong alternative
pressure_summary: Moderate performance contrast; opportunity budget unmatched
scope_or_caveat: Not matched by application count; not equivalent to later B2 systems

what_was_tested: Dormancy, reactivation, no-lifecycle comparison
comparisons: Lifecycle enabled vs disabled; reactivation probe
benchmark_conclusion: Some probes succeed; no primary value difference
scope_or_caveat: Few decision-consequential lifecycle opportunities

what_was_tested: Rotation→reflection composition on paired synthetic tasks
comparisons: Composition vs best single / no-skill solver
benchmark_conclusion: One composition pair positive in narrow setting
pressure_summary: Moderate for one pair; none for breadth
scope_or_caveat: Only one evaluable component pair; counting/grouping unavailable

what_was_tested: Covered transfer cells and negative-transfer probes
comparisons: ASFT vs B1-B4 and transfer guards
benchmark_conclusion: Positive covered transfer/cost results; mixed baseline gate; negative transfer diagnostics limited
scope_or_caveat: Source coverage uneven; structural/compositional cells unavailable; corrected posthoc view

what_was_tested: Association of TS and CGR across evaluable observations
benchmark_conclusion: Positive descriptive r about .483 but mean CGR -.060
scope_or_caveat: 36 observations in 9 clusters; not causal manipulation

what_was_tested: Removal of invariants/SCT/persistence/composition
comparisons: A1 no invariants, A2 no SCT, A3 no persistence, A4 no composition
benchmark_conclusion: Some local contrasts; A2 zero; A4 unavailable
scope_or_caveat: A4 lacked source skills; phase-specific transfer endpoint

what_was_tested: Capability scores and derived growth indices over rounds/seeds
primary_measures: C_t, CGR, CCG, IG, IGR, IE
benchmark_conclusion: Positive internal scores in one cohort; one capability persists; cross-phase growth inconsistent
pressure_summary: Weak for external capability; moderate metric movement
scope_or_caveat: Internal components; no independent capability or intelligence target

what_was_tested: C_t vs next-round task utility; TS vs CGR
benchmark_conclusion: Weak positive same-cohort C_t prediction; transfer-growth unsupported
scope_or_caveat: 30 round pairs across 10 seeds; noncausal; same generator

what_was_tested: Task utility and capability score against B1-B4
comparisons: No learning, skill storage, random skills, compression proxy
benchmark_conclusion: Mixed: ASFT fails B1 utility, passes B2-B4 on joint criterion
scope_or_caveat: C_t and utility can point in opposite directions; B4 is proxy

what_was_tested: Effect of removing IDT/SCT/skill library/composition/CGM
primary_measures: CGR, C_t, task utility, composition value
benchmark_conclusion: Some growth scores change without task utility; no-SCT CGR tie; composition value negative
scope_or_caveat: A5 metrics masked by design; construct risk

what_was_tested: Task utility, composed-task utility, CGR across arms
benchmark_conclusion: Comparator- and endpoint-specific wins/losses; no universal ASFT superiority
scope_or_caveat: Exact ties and near-zero variance for several arms

what_was_tested: Whether policies create different skill sets and outcomes
comparisons: ASFT vs frequency-only, no-SCV, random-SCV, no-lifecycle
benchmark_conclusion: Four of four candidates selected; these selection arms tie
scope_or_caveat: Selection intervention did not alter decisions

what_was_tested: Removing capability layer and observing behavior/metrics
comparisons: A3 no capability layer vs ASFT
benchmark_conclusion: Task/composition utility unchanged while CGR changes
pressure_summary: Weak for behavior; metric pathway divergence
scope_or_caveat: Score movement not task-performance evidence

what_was_tested: Exact fit of fixed 10-program DSL on public training split
benchmark_conclusion: Very low adapter coverage
scope_or_caveat: Coverage not exact task accuracy or semantic taxonomy

what_was_tested: Schema validity and order stability for discovery traces
primary_measures: 600/600 schema-valid; 3 successful fits stable across 10 permutations
comparisons: Successful vs failed bounded search traces
benchmark_conclusion: Trace schema works; useful successful population sparse
pressure_summary: No mechanism pressure for 597 no-fit tasks
scope_or_caveat: Schema-valid does not mean successful reasoning

what_was_tested: Mining successful fits, forming skills/capabilities, scoring arms
primary_measures: Invariant/skill/capability counts; transfer accuracy; holdout accuracy
benchmark_conclusion: Zero invariants/skills/capabilities; ASFT transfer 0/200; all arms holdout 1/200
pressure_summary: Mechanism decision pressure unavailable after upstream failure
scope_or_caveat: Budget discrepancy: config 3, discover default 10; same holdout retry

what_was_tested: Module implementation, test suite, MVP gates, integration
benchmark_conclusion: Phase11 note reports 24 modules, six MVP gates, 501 tests; not scientific benchmark evidence
scope_or_caveat: Phase12 files are planning/checklist records, not separate experiment results
